messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High GPU queue and autoscaler failures for customer 'AtlasHealth' private VPC (vpc-12a). gpu-inference queue > 1200 for 7m, provisioning timeouts observed.

mike (ops-oncall): Acknowledged. Getting details now. Which region?

sara: us-east-1 private cluster. Customer reported increased latencies and errors ~10:40 UTC. Their private agent is 2.1.4.

jin: current node count is at customer max (8). Pending pods show Scheduled but not started. Logs show "timed out waiting for kubelet to register" from provisioning step.

priya: Image pulls are fine. Node never joins the cluster. Control plane shows repeated attempts to attach GPU and then a provider timeout.

carlos: They intentionally turned off warm pools and added a custom taint that slows scheduling. That reduces our ability to reuse nodes quickly.

elliot: Customer impact: AtlasHealth uses this cluster for EHR inference, experiencing 500s and throughput degradation. Marking as P1 until mitigated.

support-bot: Created ticket #9876 (AtlasHealth) with initial incident notes.

mike (ops-oncall): Plan: 1) throttle incoming requests to reduce queue growth. 2) attempt emergency manual node bootstrap (delegated role). 3) enable non-PHI fallback to hosted models. Who can run the bootstrap?

sara: I'll try. I have delegated role access to their project. If that fails we'll evict noncritical pods.

jin: Hold before bootstrapping. Priya, please apply a temporary gateway throttle to 10 RPS for AtlasHealth to prevent queue blow-up.

priya: Applying patch now: ```curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/route/patch -d '{"customer":"AtlasHealth","rate_limit":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```

( :thumbsup: )
carlos: I'm bumping the autoscaler maxNodes from 8->12 in their agent config to allow extra capacity if provisioning succeeds. Note: their S3 config stores that value.

elliot: Reminder: don't exceed contractual limits without telling AE. Carlos, loop them in.

carlos: On it, pinged AE and CS. support-bot added note to ticket.

mike (ops-oncall): Sara, proceed with manual node creation and post any errors.

sara: Creating node: ```gcloud compute instances create atlas-node-emer-1 --image=redwood-base --zone=us-east1-b --machine-type=n1-standard-32 --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1```

(2m) sara: Creation failed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED for GPUs in project.

jin: That aligns with control plane reports. Customer's project GPU quota is insufficient. Autoscaler attempts were rejected by provider, causing timeouts.

elliot: So root cause is provider quota, not our autoscaler algorithm. Immediate mitigations: route non-PHI traffic to hosted fallback, and request customer to increase quotas.

mike (ops-oncall): Priya, can you enable routing rule to send non-PHI inference to hosted models? Ensure PHI stays in private cluster.

priya: Adding rule now: ```PATCH /routing/v1/customer/AtlasHealth {"fallback":"hosted-fallback-model","match":{"metadata.phi":"false"}}```

( :white_check_mark: ) priya: Rule active. Expect non-PHI QPS to drop on private cluster in ~30s.

sara: Trying second boot using an emergency project with spare GPU quota (we have cross-project emergency permission). Creating instance now.

(4m) sara: Node created successfully, kubelet registered and node Ready. Applying labels/taints to match cluster requirements.

jin: Rescheduling pending pods onto the new node. Evicting low-priority batch pods to free resources: ```kubectl get pods -n atlas | grep Pending | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -r kubectl delete pod -n atlas```

(6m) carlos: To avoid noisy retries against cloud API, I'm patching the private agent to set cloudProvisionBackoff=15m when quota errors appear. Also adjusted scaleUp delay heuristics.

elliot: Please notify account management and log change. Also, we need a runbook update to prefer fallback routing when quota rejections occur.

mike (ops-oncall): Status update: queue depth dropped from ~1200 to ~320 after fallback + new node. Customer error rate dropped from 22% -> 4%. Monitoring.

support-bot: AtlasHealth contact notified of partial mitigation and steps to request quota bump. Ticket updated with mitigation timeline.

priya: Created temporary dashboard focusing on pod start failures and provider quota rejection errors; snapshot saved for postmortem.

(10m) sara: New node stable, pods starting normally. We'll keep fallback rule active for 30 minutes and re-evaluate.

jin: Post-incident action items: 1) update runbook for no-warm-pool private clusters, 2) ensure emergency cross-project quotas are documented and accessible, 3) autoscaler should convert provider quota rejects into soft failures with automatic fallback routing.

carlos: I'll prepare a customer-facing note on how to request GPU quota increases and offer assistance.

elliot: Scheduling blameless postmortem. Priority fix: detect quota rejection earlier and trigger automatic fallback instead of repeated provisioning attempts.

mike (ops-oncall): Good job team. Demoting to P2 after 30m stable metrics. Keep thread open for follow-up and postmortem. If we see regressions ping with :rotating_light:. Closing active page, leaving thread for actions. :heart:
